name: Chisel
text: Adopt the strict schema with `speaker_id` as nullable string and a reserved placeholder "off-screen" only for raw transcription outputs. name: Sift
text: The "off-screen" placeholder still leaks ambiguity—teams will treat it as a valid speaker ID, corrupting speaker analytics. The trade-off is that downstream systems must gracefully handle missing speaker IDs, but that’s the correct burden to place.
